name: Judith
heading: Fantastic Time
text: We had a fantastic time in this villa. The location was convenient and the villa was comfortable. The pool was beautiful. Cem was extremely helpful. Highly recommended thank you!

name: Elly
heading: Super Helpful Host
text: Cem was super helpful and sorted our transfer there and back and his place is so beautiful and idealic location, with lovely pool though a little cold but it was end of October but still managed to use pool. Villa close to Hisarönü town and short bus ride to Ölüdeniz. Blue lagoon was lovely to swim in and not overcrowded. Would definitely use Cem's villa again. Thankyou for a memorable stay.

name: Sophie
heading: Lovely & Modern
text: The villa was lovely & modern & clean. It was enough space for all of us (three adults & one child). It is a close walk to Hisarönü town which has lots of shops & restaurants.

name: An
heading: Tolles Haus
text: Sehr sympathischer Gastgeber und ein tolles Haus und super Lage - dicht zum Strand und ebenso nah zur Stadt. Vielen Dank.

name: Steven
heading: Home From Home
text: We have just had a week at Cem's house. It really was a home from home. Great swimming pool (meticulously cared for). Very good beds, huge bathrooms with plenty of hot water. Air conditioning in every room. It's an easy walk into Hisarönü, and a very short taxi ride to the wonderful Blue Lagoon beach. Cem was a great host, very responsive. It was our first trip to Turkey and we loved it. Would happily stay here again.

name: Anna
heading: Très Belle Villa
text: Très belle villa sur deux étages. De nombreux restaurants et épiceries/supermarchés à côté. Un bus pour se rendre à la plage ou y aller en taxi, de nombreux taxis passent dans le coin. Je recommande !

name: Ella
heading: Wonderful Stay
text: We had a wonderful stay for 9 days. The villa was pristine and had many helpful amenities. Brilliant location, plenty of shops and restaurants nearby. The pool and outside area was gorgeous and well kept. Cem and his family were very responsive and kind to us throughout our stay. We would definitely visit again and recommend to friends.

name: Dani
heading: Beautiful Villa
text: We had a wonderful 10-day stay at this beautiful villa in Ovacık at the foot of Babadağ. The view from the balcony was stunning. Location was perfect – 7 mins to Hisarönü, restaurants on the doorstep, supermarket 2 mins away. The villa was modern, spacious, spotless, with all amenities. All bedrooms had private bathrooms & air con. Cem was an excellent host – responsive, arranged great transfers, and allowed late checkout.

name: Yusuf
heading: Beklentileri Karşıladı
text: Beklentilerimizi sonuna kadar karşılayan bir yerdi. Tekrar gittiğimde aynı yerde kalmak isterim. Ev sahibi anlayışlı ve yardım severdi. Bu güzel konaklama için kendilerine teşekkür ederim.

name: Ayşe
heading: Temiz ve Huzurlu
text: Ev gayet temizdi, Cem bey ve ailesi dost canlısı ve tatlıydı. Havuz her gün temizleniyordu, güvenlikle alakalı hiç sıkıntı yaşamadık. Sessiz ve huzur doluydu, konumu gayet serindi klimasız uyunabiliyordu. Mutfaktaki gereçler yeterliydi.

name: Sercan
heading: Memnun Ayrıldık
text: Cem bey ilgiliydi, evin konumu gayet güzeldi ve marketlere yakındı tüm ihtiyaçlarımızı kolayca hallettik. Havuz hergün düzenli temizlendi. Memnun ayrıldık, teşekkürler.

name: Ömer
heading: Rahat ve Konforlu
text: Konaklamamız gayet rahat ve konforlu geçti. Cem bey çok hızlı bir şekilde aksiyon alıp gerekeni yaptı. Tatilimizin başından sonuna kadar isteklerimize çok hızlı bir şekilde yerine getirdi. Konum olarak Hisarönü ve Ölüdeniz'e çok yakın bir villa idi. Hem ev sahibi hem villanın konumu merkezi bir yerde olmasından dolayı biz çok memnun kaldık, tekrar geleceğiz inşallah.

name: Şeyda Nur
heading: Huzur ve Kolaylık
text: Konum olarak heryere ulaşımı kolay olan ve çok güzel bir evde konakladık. Herşey çok ince düşünülmüştü. Cem bey çok ilgili ve dost canlısı, bize gerçekten çok yardımcı oldu. Ailecek çok özel nazik insanlar. Huzur bulmak kafa dinlemek istiyorsanız, heryere ulaşımın kolay olsun diyorsanız kesinlikle tercih edilmesi gereken mükemmel bir yer.

name: Andrew
heading: Clean & Tidy
text: The villa is very clean & tidy with plenty of room. Beautiful views of the mountains from the garden & balcony's. I would definitely like to stay there again.

name: Egemen
heading: Beautifully Designed
text: Cem was great, very communicative and responsive. His place is beautifully designed, with brand new furniture and fully equipped kitchen amenities. I hope to stay at his place again soon!

name: Yasin
heading: Holiday Home
text: Booked this place for my family instead of a hotel. Wanted to feel somewhat like a holiday home and that's exactly what it was. It was super clean, exactly how the pictures show and the host Cem was just a great reason to feel right at home. The location was perfect for me and my family. Walking distance to all the shops or a 3 minute car journey. Cem if you read this, thank you for an amazing holiday.

name: Kübra
heading: Harika Ev Sahibi
text: Cem bey harika bir ev sahibi. İlk günden itibaren sürekli iletişim halinde olması ve evin açıklamalarını fotoğraflarını çok net ve doğru bilgi sunduğu için teşekkür ediyorum. Ev tasarımı, düzeni, temizliği, her türlü ihtiyacın ev içerisinde olması muazzam. Çok huzurlu ve mutlu bir tatil yaptık ailecek. Şu ana kadar kaldığım en iyi evler arasında. Umarım tekrardan bu evde tatil yapma fırsatı buluruz.

name: Belemir
heading: Misafirperver
text: Ev sahibi Cem Bey ve ailesi oldukça ilgili, güler yüzlü, misafirperverlerdi. Kendisi çevrede gidilecek yerler konusunda da bizi bilgilendirdi, yardımcı oldu. Evin konumu her yere yakın mesafede olduğu gibi, içi, eşyalar da son derece yeni, yeterli ve temizdi. Her şeyden çok memnun kaldık. Tekrar görüşmek üzere.

name: James
heading: 5 Stars
text: Fantastic host, beautiful villa. 5 stars.

name: Michelle
heading: Exceeded Expectations
text: The house was absolutely beautiful and exceeded all expectations!! The host was very friendly and the garden/pool was checked every day to ensure everything was as it should be. I will 100% be returning in the future. Myself, my partner and our children had the best break here.

name: Tracy
heading: Modern & Spacious
text: The villa is modern and spacious. Everything was perfect. Cem was very helpful with any extra requests. I hope to stay again if I visit this area again. Thank you Cem.

name: Rebecca
heading: Amazing Stay
text: Amazing stay, the villa was very clean and as described. Cem is very responsive and was quick to reply to questions we had. The views are amazing and sunsets over the mountain are an incredible sight. I would highly recommend. The villa is in between 2 taxi buttons and is a short walk to the main strip.

name: Samuel
heading: Beautiful Area
text: It is located in a beautiful area, close to loads of restaurants and other amenities. It is exactly as described. I would surely recommend it to anyone that wishes to holiday in the area.

name: Gino
heading: Best Airbnb Ever
text: This is probably the best Airbnb place I have ever been. The villa is fantastic, the swimming pool is so clean. The place is literally 2min walk to the supermarket, and 5min walk to the town. I asked Cem to prepare something for our anniversary and he helped me straight away. The jacuzzi also is amazing. Seriously this place was worth it! Highly recommend it.

name: Basil
heading: Highly Recommended
text: 4 of us stayed at the property - it was beautiful. Great pool, peaceful surroundings, close to restaurants. Highly recommended!

name: Karin
heading: Schöner Aufenthalt
text: Wir hatten einen schönen Aufenthalt mit der Familie im Haus. Das Haus war modern und gemütlich eingerichtet, es ist viel Platz und in der Küche findet man alles, was man braucht.

name: Corine
heading: Perfect Stay
text: Wonderful two week stay. Villa was perfect, very comfortable and exactly as expected. Cem was great at responding to all queries and his dad the owner was very kind and friendly. We highly recommend.

name: Jason
heading: Most Wonderful Stay
text: We had the most wonderful stay and thank you for our cucumbers, our son absolutely loved them!

name: Andrew
heading: Excellent Hosts
text: Hometown villa is modern and very comfortable with all amenities needed for an enjoyable stay. There are great views of the Babadağ mountain from the villa. The area around the two swimming pools makes for great sunbathing plus there is a large outdoor seating area. The villa is in a great location for all that Ovacık and Hisarönü have to offer. Cem & his family are excellent hosts. Cem was very responsive, and nothing was too much trouble. We would highly recommend this villa.

name: Sonya
heading: Lovely 12 Day Stay
text: We had a lovely 12 day stay at the villa and would definitely recommend staying here. The villa itself is beautiful, clean and spacious. The pool was great and was cleaned daily. The beaches and other attractions are a 10 minute taxi drive away, and there are supermarkets and restaurants within walking distance. Cem was friendly and very helpful, giving us local recommendations which all proved perfect.

name: Sophie
heading: Our Favourite Villa
text: Probably our favourite villa we've stayed in so far. Exactly as described and so modern. Plenty of amenities and Nevzat was super friendly and made you feel very welcome. Cem the host was great in organising our time. The villa location is perfect and in a great spot making you feel very safe. Walking distance to Hisarönü. We could not fault the villa one bit. 100% recommend!

name: Cameron
heading: Really Nice Villa
text: Cem was really responsive, if I had any questions he was always there to answer them promptly. Villa is really nice and spacious, within 10 minute walk to Hisarönü strip. Would definitely recommend.

name: Amy-Rose
heading: Faultless Hospitality
text: 10/10 faultless hospitality. The accommodation matches exactly to the description and photos, where there's also an option to have a BBQ in the back near the pool. Nevzat was very accommodating, cleaning the pool every morning and even gave us fresh cucumbers he grew nearby. A very good family run accommodation and will be returning.

name: Louisa
heading: Amazing Villa
text: It was an amazing villa. Beautiful views of Babadağ. Lovely pool. Really well kitted out. Comfortable beds. The owner's dad was so sweet and helpful recommending supermarkets and restaurants. Would definitely recommend.

name: Trudy
heading: Great Stay
text: We had a great stay here. The villa was clean and very comfortable. The outside areas are brilliant. Plenty of seating areas, pool was good. There are good restaurants within 5 minutes walk. Buses are frequent and cheap. We found it was a good location to visit lots of places. Really enjoyed our stay.

name: Rachel
heading: Best Time
text: We had the best time at this Airbnb! It is absolutely beautiful, and the house is exactly like the photos. Everything was so clean and the beds were so comfortable. The location is perfect - you can easily walk to markets and restaurants. The backyard is private and has beautiful views of the mountains. Cem and his family were so kind and always responded very quickly to any questions we had!

name: Mervenur
heading: Evimizde Gibi
text: Cem Bey çok güler yüzlü ve insan canlısı biri. Kendimizi evimizde gibi hissettiğimiz, tüm gereçlerin mevcut olduğu, tertemiz villası ve ev sahibimizin Fethiye hakkında verdiği tavsiyeler sayesinde hem ev hem de Fethiye gezimizden çok memnun kalarak ayrıldık. Kesinlikle tavsiye ediyorum!

name: Christopher
heading: Great Value
text: We thought the villa was great value. It was spacious, very comfortable, there was a lovely swimming pool and you are close to plenty of shops and some good restaurants. Mainly you are two miles from amazing beaches. The property is exactly as you see in the photographs.

name: Abay
heading: Очень комфортно
text: Было очень комфортно, хозяин жилья предоставил все принадлежности, которые мы попросили. Жилье находится вблизи продуктового магазина, что очень удобно. Имеется парковка для машины. Пляж в 10 мин езды. Если в будущем приедем в Олюдениз, остановимся именно здесь.

name: Mohammad
heading: Clean & Peaceful
text: It was so clean, we had everything we needed. It is a quiet and peaceful environment. We went to Blue Lagoon, used Teleferik, went to Göcek and spent time in Fethiye. The host is so responsive and friendly and all the time we got a reply so fast.

name: Didiana
heading: Perfect Trip
text: We had an amazing stay. The villa is new, modern, very clean and comfortable. Not to mention very beautiful as well. It is exactly as shown in pictures! The bedrooms are spacious, very comfortable and each have a bathroom and balcony. The living room and kitchen has everything you need. The host was lovely and helpful and their private transfer service was amazing. Our stay was perfect! Highly recommend.

name: Viktor
heading: Modern & Stylish
text: The villa is modern, new and stylish. It met our expectations in full. It was all clean. There is a lot of kitchenware. The bedding experience was great. There is a large private parking lot. Beautiful view of Babadağ. Close to Ölüdeniz teleferik and beach. We had a great stay here.

name: Elif
heading: Top Lage
text: Ich fand den Aufenthalt sehr gut. Die Lage ist einfach top. Die Kommunikation war super, jederzeit erreichbar. Und bei Aktivitäten wurde auch weitergeholfen. Ich kann es einfach nur weiterempfehlen!

name: Yuri
heading: Super Ventilada
text: Nos receberam muito bem! O espaço é realmente como descrito, a casa é super ventilada! A internet é super boa para home office. Sua localização é super fácil acesso para as vans que levam para a praia. Com certeza se voltarmos para Ölüdeniz ficaríamos aqui novamente! Muito obrigada pelos dias incríveis!

name: Fatih
heading: Schönes Design
text: Es war eine sehr schöne Unterkunft und hat wirklich allem entsprochen, wie es beschrieben wurde. Es ist eine neu errichtete Unterkunft mit optisch schönem Design in einer ruhigen Atmosphäre.

name: Viktoryia
heading: Красивый вид
text: Мне очень понравилась квартира. Очень красивый вид из балкона. Квартира была очень чистая. В квартире есть все необходимое. Кондиционеры в каждой комнате, летом это огромный плюс.

name: Dale
heading: Gorgeous Property
text: Property was gorgeous, clean, modern, well equipped and perfect for our family. Hosts were very welcoming, friendly and attentive. Even flexible with check in and check out. Would stay here again.

name: 혜진
heading: 깔끔한 숙소
text: 깔끔하고 에어컨, 세탁기가 잘 작동합니다. 호스트가 답변이 빨라서 문제가 생겨도 쉽게 해결할 수 있었습니다.

name: Владислав
heading: Well Furnished
text: We enjoyed our stay at the villa. It is well furnished. There are sofas with changing seat positions and a music system at the hall. There are lots of supermarkets and restaurants around. Overall our stay was great.

name: Kirill
heading: Cozy & Comfortable
text: We really enjoyed our stay in Cem's place. Very cozy and comfortable apartment in a peaceful district with a nice view. We had everything we needed and the communication was on the highest level. Very kind and helped us a lot with all our specific needs during the stay. Highly recommended!

name: Juan Pablo
heading: Well Located
text: The apartment is well located, close to the city center but in a very quiet neighborhood. The apartment has air conditioner in the main room and in the living room. The bathroom was very clean.

name: Muayad
heading: More Than Perfect
text: Everything was perfect and more than perfect, I am very satisfied.

name: Gülen
heading: Huzurlu Konum
text: Ölüdeniz merkezindeki gürültü patırtıdan uzak ve daha serin. Özel otoparkının olması harika. Mutfakta ihtiyaç duyduğum herşey temin edildi. Bundan sonra ilk değerlendireceğimiz konaklama burası olacak. Ev sahibine ilgisinden dolayı teşekkür ederim.

name: Seda
heading: Huzur Dolu
text: Kaldığımız zaman aralığında evde tüm ihtiyaçlarımızı karşıladık. Cem Bey ve babası gereken ilgi ve alakayı gösterdi, çok içten samimi bir yer. Huzur dolu, sakin, havası temiz bir yer. Ev içerisinde istediğiniz olanaklar mevcut, Netflix gibi uygulamalar bile mevcut. Kısacası herşey düşünülmüş. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederim.

name: Mert
heading: Herşey Mükemmeldi
text: Herşey mükemmeldi, kusursuz. Ayrıca bahçeden organik salatalık, soğan, otlar çok güzeldi ve taze ekmek ikramı da çok güzeldi. Tekrar gitsem yine aynı yerde kalırım.

name: Tugba
heading: Konforlu ve Tertemiz
text: Sadece hafta sonu için konakladık. Çok konforlu ve tertemizdi. Evde tüm eşyalar kaliteli ve iyi düşünülmüştü. Ev sahibi aile çok cana yakındı. Daha uzun süre kalamadığımız için üzüldük.

name: James
heading: Unbelievable
text: In a one word summary - Unbelievable. The apartment itself - wow! It was perfect. The kitchen had everything we needed, the pool was awesome, amazing bedrooms, wonderful bathrooms, great views, great location. The villa is located about a 15 minute walk from the main strip. Cem was amazing and his family was so friendly too. Amazing value. I would love to be back!

name: Roman
heading: Great Host
text: Great and very helpful host. Every request or need we had was almost immediately satisfied. Very clean place, new equipment in the kitchen, 2 swimming pools, very modern house. A good place to stay with your family.

name: Oleksandr
heading: Beautiful Place
text: It's a beautiful place to spend time with family. Villa is well equipped. We enjoyed our stay so much we wanted to extend but it was already booked. Maybe we'll return next time!
